mentions.name: London LLM hackathon & study group
mentions.description: A London community of LLM hackers built over six months, running guided hackathons (with planned daily goals) and collaborative study sessions that explore topics such as pulling GPT apart and rebuilding it by hand, ARC AGI 2026, fine-tuning, and making GPT funny.
mentions.audience: Curious LLM hackers in London who want to push the edge of what they can do with large language models.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've spent 6 months building a network of curious LLM hackers in London who want to push the edge of what we can do.

This Friday we pull GPT apart and rebuild bits by hand. A few weeks back we tackled ARC AGI 2026. Prevoiusly we did fine tuning and making GPT funny.

It is a sort of a guided hackathon (generally I plan goals for the day) and collaborative study group.
